record.paper_title: Model Theory of Tame Valued Fields and Beyond: Recent Developments and Open Questions
record.original_question: Let F_p(t)^h denote the henselization of the t-adically valued rational function field (F_p(t),v_t). Is F_p(t)^h an elementary substructure of the Laurent series field F_p((t)) with its t-adic valuation? The paper notes that existential closedness of F_p(t)^h in F_p((t)) is known, but full elementary equivalence of the inclusion remains open.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p$ be a prime number, and let $\mathbb{F}_p$ denote the field with $p$ elements. Consider the rational function field $\mathbb{F}_p(t)$ equipped with the $t$-adic valuation $v_t$, defined on $\mathbb{F}_p[t]$ by $v_t(f) = \max\{n \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0} : t^n \mid f\}$ and extended to $\mathbb{F}_p(t)$ in the standard way. Let $(\mathbb{F}_p(t)^h, v_t)$ denote the henselization of the valued field $(\mathbb{F}_p(t), v_t)$, i.e., the smallest henselian valued field extension of $(\mathbb{F}_p(t), v_t)$ inside a fixed algebraic closure. Let $\mathbb{F}_p((t))$ denote the field of formal Laurent series over $\mathbb{F}_p$, equipped with its natural $t$-adic valuation. There is a canonical inclusion of valued fields
$$ (\mathbb{F}_p(t)^h, v_t) \hookrightarrow (\mathbb{F}_p((t)), v_t). $$
It is known that $(\mathbb{F}_p(t)^h, v_t)$ is existentially closed in $(\mathbb{F}_p((t)), v_t)$.

Question: Is $(\mathbb{F}_p(t)^h, v_t)$ an elementary substructure of $(\mathbb{F}_p((t)), v_t)$ in the language of valued fields? Equivalently, does the inclusion above preserve and reflect the truth of every first-order formula (with parameters from $\mathbb{F}_p(t)^h$) in the language of valued fields?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether the henselization of $(\mathbb{F}_p(t), v_t)$ is an elementary substructure of $(\mathbb{F}_p((t)), v_t)$ is a well-known open problem in the model theory of valued fields in positive characteristic. Existential closedness is classical, but full elementary equivalence of the inclusion is not established; it is closely tied to the still-open problem of decidability/model-completeness of $\mathbb{F}_p((t))$. No solution was located in the literature search.

status_evidence.title: The Defect (F.-V. Kuhlmann)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of defect in valued fields of positive characteristic, discussing obstructions to model-theoretic transfer between F_p(t)^h and F_p((t)).
status_evidence.claim: Foundational issues regarding model theory of F_p((t)) and its henselian subfields remain open due to the wild defect phenomenon in positive characteristic.

status_evidence.title: F_p((X)) is decidable as a module over the ring of additive polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses model-theoretic properties of F_p((t)); decidability of F_p((t)) as a valued field is a long-standing open problem.
status_evidence.claim: Full first-order theory of F_p((t)) is not known to coincide with that of its henselian rational subfield.
